subject: Request: post-report continuity endorsement for SOC 2 Type II (InsightGrid)
messages:
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@insightgrid.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 post-report continuity endorsement

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our GRC team. We’re in the middle of a procurement review and need a short formal endorsement from Redwood that covers the period after the end date on your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2027-06-30) up to a recent date (we need confirmation for activity through 2027-08-03).

Specifically: can you provide a one-page signed endorsement (sometimes called a bridge/continuity letter) stating that there have been no changes to control environments or exceptions affecting the scope since 2027-06-30, or otherwise disclosing any material exceptions? If there are exceptions, please include mitigation and expected remediation dates.

Attachments: I’ve attached our intake questionnaire in case you want to reference our format.

Timing: their deadline is EOD Friday (2027-08-06). Could you let me know a realistic turnaround and whether you can sign via DocuSign?

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Michael
Michael Torres
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
InsightGrid
Attachments: InsightGrid_info_request_form.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 post-report continuity endorsement

Forwarding InsightGrid's request — they need a signed one-page endorsement covering 2027-06-30 through 2027-08-03. Deadline EOD 2027-08-06.

Marissa — can Compliance draft something brief (we typically say "no known exceptions affecting scope" unless there is an open item) and flag any control changes if relevant?

David — once Compliance has a draft, can Legal review for signature language and add the signatory block? We prefer a standard executive signature (COO or Head of Security). Jonas — heads up; this is the deal we discussed last quarter.

I’ll loop back to InsightGrid with DocuSign if we can get final by Thursday afternoon.

— Stephanie
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 post-report continuity endorsement

On Tue, Aug 3, 2027 at 9:33 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Forwarding InsightGrid's request — they need a signed one-page endorsement covering 2027-06-30 through 2027-08-03. Deadline EOD 2027-08-06.

Thanks — drafting now. Quick status note from Compliance: no control exceptions were opened in July, and the only change in the window was a minor rotation of a key in our secrets-management system on 2027-07-12 (routine; logged and reviewed). I do not believe this is a material change to control effectiveness but will disclose it in a single sentence to be transparent.

Attached is the initial draft (redline) for your review: "redline_postreport_endorsement_v1.docx". Key points:
- Affirm report coverage through 2027-06-30.
- State that, to the best of Redwood's knowledge, no material exceptions affecting the report scope have arisen between 2027-07-01 and 2027-08-03.
- Call out the secrets rotation on 2027-07-12 and indicate it was performed per policy with compensating review steps.
- Provide proposed signatory: COO (name withheld until Legal advises on language).

Next steps: Legal review (David) for liability language and signatory block; after sign-off I can produce a final PDF for signature. Please review by EOD Wednesday so we can turn this around.

Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_postreport_endorsement_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 post-report continuity endorsement

On Wed, Aug 4, 2027 at 10:20 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Attached is the initial draft (redline) for your review: "redline_postreport_endorsement_v1.docx".

Thanks — reviewed and made minor edits to tighten the limited-scope assurance language and signatory block. I removed language that could imply an ongoing warranty and added the typical "to the best of our knowledge" qualifier.

I converted the redline to a final PDF and attached it here: "redline_postreport_endorsement_final.pdf". Proposed signatory: COO, Emiko Sato.

Plan: Stephanie, if you approve, I suggest we route this via DocuSign this afternoon. I’ve initiated a DocuSign envelope for InsightGrid (link below) and set a 48-hour reminder.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/AAABBB-InsightGrid-Bridge-2027

If nothing else, I’ll send the PDF to Michael with a short cover note and the signing link.

David Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
